name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: id
label: Testimonial
help: The testimonial (tm_...). The list shows the newest ones. You can also map a testimonial ID from an earlier module.

name: body
label: Body
help: The words. A change is kept in the history

name: title
label: Title
help: Up to 200 characters. A change is kept in the history

name: rating
label: Rating
help: 1 to 5, or null to clear it. A change is kept in the history

name: highlight
label: Highlight
help: An exact part of the words. Empty clears it

name: received_at
label: Received At
help: When they gave it. A day alone (2026-10-10) is that day by the site's clock

name: source_name
label: Source Name
help: The platform or place it came from

name: properties
label: Properties
help: Custom property values by key as a JSON object, like {"plan":"pro"}.

name: edit_note
label: Edit Note
help: A line kept with the history entry, up to 280 characters

name: add_tags
label: Add Tags
help: Tag names or IDs. A name that does not exist yet is created.

name: remove_tags
label: Remove Tags
help: Tag names or ids to remove

name: permalink
label: Permalink
help: Switches its public page (/t/<tm_id>) on or off. The page responds only while the testimonial is approved, not in the trash and allowed by its consent record
